3. Type and starting counter
Carpet production formula
Production (m²) = Running picks × Width (cm) ÷ (Picks per cm × 10) × Carpets at once
Running picks = the difference between two counter readings (approved entries only). Stop time is never counted, because a stopped machine produces nothing.
This formula gives the right area only if the machine counter shows thousands of picks (1 on the counter = 1,000 picks). Please confirm that with your expert using one machine.
Width and Picks per cm come from each machine (edit them in the list below). "Carpets at once" is 1 now, so nothing is changed.

Shift rules

The rule marked “Active now” is the one in use. Every change starts from the date you choose, so older readings keep the rule that was running then.

Add or edit a shift rule
Add a New Rule
1. Starts from

Readings dated on or after this date use this rule. Use a future date to prepare a change ahead of time (for example the first day of Ramadan).

2. Shift hours
3. Machine hours and photo cutover

Machine hours: the shorter number that production and efficiency use (for example 11.5), separate from the full shift length above. Cutover: a reading before this clock time is saved as a Starting photo, from this time on as an Ending photo.

4. When each one locks (grace period)

Weekly automatic stop

For one weekday (for example every Thursday) a fixed cleaning stop is applied to every running machine and that day’s machine hours are reduced to match.

Add or edit a weekly stop rule
Add a Rule
1. Which day

Applies to this weekday from the date on. Earlier dates stay as they are.

Machine re-entry cooldown

After a reading is logged, that machine leaves the list for this long. It stops an accidental second entry, then comes back by itself.

What Executive Management Can See

Controls which profile sections an Executive Management user can open when they view an employee's record from the Dashboard. This never affects what Admin or the employee themselves can see.

Who Can See Passport Location & Renewal Status

This is separate from every other permission in the app — nobody sees this section on an employee's Passport tab unless Admin puts them here, no matter what role or pages they otherwise have.

Add Someone

Write / Read & Write is capped at 2 people — these are your two Approvers. A change one of them proposes needs the other one's sign-off before it takes effect. Read-only Viewers can be added without limit.

Salary Month

Where a salary month starts and ends. The whole app follows it: Accounts (salary sheets, joining and leaving days), Employee Overview, My Status, Reports, and every “this month / last month” filter. Change it here and everything follows.

Working Days & Holidays

Marking a day as a Holiday only affects the expected working-hours calculation on the Dashboard's Machine & Production section — it doesn't lock anyone out or stop them logging readings on that day. If part of the factory genuinely runs on a Friday, that's fine; that day's real production still shows up as normal, it just won't count as an "expected" working day when totalling hours.

Quick Setup — Mark Every Friday

The usual weekly off day. Do this once per year instead of one Friday at a time.

Add a Specific Holiday

Eid, National Day, or any other one-off closure — a reason is required so it's clear later why that day doesn't count.

Marked Holidays

Clean Up & Refresh

Backup & restore machines
Restore Machines

Every time your machine list is saved, a backup copy is kept automatically — no need to remember to download anything. If your machine list is ever showing wrong or blank details, restore it here.

Clean Up Old Reading Photos

Removes the PHOTO from readings in the date range below — the date, shift, reading value, diff, stop time, and everything else about the entry stays exactly as it is, permanently, for your records. Only the photo itself is deleted, to free up space once entries are old enough that nobody needs to look at the photo anymore. This cannot be undone — once a photo is deleted here, it's gone.

Refresh All Calculations

Every edit already updates the affected machine automatically. Press this if a number in an operator's profile, the Dashboard or Approvals ever looks wrong, or after making a lot of edits — it re-checks every machine's approved readings and corrects any saved total that doesn't match. It only changes what is actually wrong, so it is safe to press as often as you like, and it tells you exactly what it fixed.

Departments

Used across machines, employees, and the CEO Dashboard filters.

Positions

Shown as a dropdown on every employee's profile.

Leave / Request Types

Shown as a dropdown when an employee applies for leave. Changes case to case, so keep this up to date.

Stop Reasons

Shown as a numbered dropdown when logging a machine stop. The Report page shows just the number, so reordering changes the number for new entries only. Picks/Hour is what an operator earns for each hour stopped for that reason — leave it 0 if that reason shouldn't earn picks at all.

Salary Components

Extra pay line items admin can add beyond Basic Salary / Extra Money / Premium Money — shown on every employee's Salary Info tab.

Premium Money — Pay-Per-Pick Tiers

Applies only to employees marked "Eligible for Premium Money" on their Salary Info tab. Different machines can pay different amounts for the same pick range — assign specific machines to a tier, or leave it blank to apply to every machine.
